sentences.en: You will see a forest of masts in the harbor.
sentences.zh: 你会看到港口里有一片桅杆林。

sentences.en: The hunter went deep into the forest, never to return.
sentences.zh: 猎人深入森林腹地，再也没回来。

sentences.en: This tree is the tallest and oldest in this forest.
sentences.zh: 这棵树是这片森林中最高最老的树。

senses.zh: 森林；丛林；（森林似的）一丛
在…造林；使长满树林；使成为森林
